description: Three phases of one scheduling decision · 8 lanes · target 3 completions per bucket. Switch Lanes / requests and Buckets / debt within each checkpoint. B1: L=1; B2: 1<L≤2; B4: 2<L≤4; B8: 4<L≤8. Color denotes completion bucket for EOS, grant endpoint for active work, next eligible frontier for waiting work.

checkpoints.label: 1 · Observe debt and released lanes
checkpoints.narrative: `f_2` means 2 decoded chunks; `f_2 → f_4` grants execution up to 4 chunks. `f_0` means no chunks decoded. `B_b` is a final-length bucket. Unfinished requests have no observed completion bucket. Both tabs show the same checkpoint. Observed EOS: A/B/C in B1; D in B2; E in B4; n=(3,1,1,0), d=(0,2,2,3). F/G/H/I keep their grants. Released at a frontier without EOS: J (`f_4`), K (`f_4`), L (`f_4`), M (`f_4`); 4 slots can be reassigned. Resident: N (`f_1`), O (`f_2`), P (`f_4`), Q (`f_4`). Pending: R (`f_0`), S (`f_0`), T (`f_0`), U (`f_0`).

checkpoints.label: 2 · Allocate service and check supply
checkpoints.narrative: `f_2` means 2 decoded chunks; `f_2 → f_4` grants execution up to 4 chunks. `f_0` means no chunks decoded. `B_b` is a final-length bucket. Unfinished requests have no observed completion bucket. Both tabs show the same checkpoint. With mean service mu=(1,2,4,8), w=max(d,0) × mu=(0,4,8,24). Largest-remainder rounding of 8w/36 gives L=(0,1,2,5). Keep F_c=(0,1,1,2); R=4, so A=(0,0,1,3). Eligible candidates: `f_1`: R/S/T/U; `f_2`: N; `f_4`: O; `f_8`: J/P/Q/K/L/M. Grants are filled in frontier order, then waiting order among matching requests, while keeping engine ownership. Proposed: O→E0.L3/`f_4`, J→E0.L4/`f_8`, P→E1.L3/`f_8`, Q→E1.L4/`f_8`. `No supply miss or spill`. N stays resident: eligible for `f_2`, but no new grant is requested there. This is a proposal; lanes have not moved.

checkpoints.label: 3 · Apply grants; preserve frozen work
checkpoints.narrative: `f_2` means 2 decoded chunks; `f_2 → f_4` grants execution up to 4 chunks. `f_0` means no chunks decoded. `B_b` is a final-length bucket. Unfinished requests have no observed completion bucket. Both tabs show the same checkpoint. Applied: O→E0.L3/`f_4`, J→E0.L4/`f_8`, P→E1.L3/`f_8`, Q→E1.L4/`f_8`. F/G/H/I are unchanged. Resident after: K (`f_4`), L (`f_4`), M (`f_4`), N (`f_1`). Pending: R (`f_0`), S (`f_0`), T (`f_0`), U (`f_0`). Actual=(0,1,2,5); `No supply miss or spill`. No decode time elapses across these decision phases, so n and debt stay fixed; granting is not completing.
